behaviors_asserted: Client accepts a custom fetch implementation via options.
ClientResponse types assume native fetch methods like res.ok, res.json(), res.text().
ofetch throws on non-2xx responses instead of returning a Response object with ok: false.
TypeScript cannot infer that non-2xx responses will never arrive as normal response objects when using ofetch.
Users must add type workarounds like res200() after every RPC call.
